journal.text:
I read lineage_bench.py (lines 1-107) and then minbpe/base.py, minbpe/regex.py and minbpe/basic.py, the last three in the line ranges recorded for this session. The aim was to understand how the benchmark exercises the tokenizers before choosing anything to change.

Nothing was measured. I made no edits and ran no sandbox evaluations, and the session stopped without submitting a candidate. I have no results to quote.

What I believe now is limited to what reading gives me. I have not checked any claim about where time goes or what the benchmark rewards against a run, so any idea I formed about hot spots in the merge or encode paths is unverified and should be treated as a guess.

Next session I should run lineage_bench.py on the unmodified code first to get a baseline, then profile which of basic.py or regex.py dominates. Only after that should I make one small change, evaluate it in the sandbox, and submit if it holds up.
